newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-FIS HAILS SESTRIERE AS A SUCCESS.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-FIS HAILS SESTRIERE AS A SUCCESS.

text.p: The International Ski Federation (FIS) on Saturday hailed the Alpine world championships as a record-breaking success.
FIS president Marc Hodler said a record number of 59 countries had participated and more television viewers had tuned in their sets to the action than ever before.
"The ratings at home of TV viewers have reached new records," he declared. No figures were given.
Crowds were small at many races in the first week and the world body said earlier in the championships that it was disappointed by the low turnout of spectators.
Hodler also said that the top four in every race had been dope tested and all the results so far were negative.
"We pay tribute to the organising committee for having prepared these Alpine championships very well," he told a news conference on the final day of the championships.
